submission.justification: Module-D2 has the highest light yield but fails thermal cycling (30% against a 5% limit), so it is excluded. Module-D3 is the next best at 27 PE/MeV at 20% coverage and passes with 2% failures. D1 also passes, but it yields only 18 PE/MeV. Light collection rises with coverage, and feedthroughs are available up to 30%. At 30% coverage I estimate D3 gives about 37 PE/MeV, from 27×1.5^0.8. The 2% failure rate comes from a batch of 40, which is about 1 module. That is a small sample, so the true rate has wide uncertainty and the 5% margin is not guaranteed.

requirements.evidence: D3 at 30% coverage is about 37 PE/MeV, the best among designs that pass the thermal-cycling requirement. This is an extrapolation using the coverage^0.8 scaling.

requirements.requirement: Design is one of the three candidates
At most 5% failures after 20 thermal cycles
requirements.evidence: D3 had 2% failures in a batch of 40 (about 1 module). The sample is small, so this is not statistically robust.
30% coverage is at the upper limit, and the feedthroughs support it.
